definitions.explanation: A bank account where money is deposited. The general term covering savings accounts, checking accounts, and other types of deposit accounts.

notes:
A practical banking term that anyone living in Japan will encounter. Essential vocabulary for setting up daily life in Japan, as many services require a Japanese bank account ({預金|よきん}{口座|こうざ}) for salary payments, utility bills, and rent.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {預金|よきん}{口座|こうざ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開設|かいせつ}する→開設する：30272_kaisetsusuru⟧: to open a bank account (formal)
- {預金|よきん}{口座|こうざ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: to open a bank account
- {預金|よきん}{口座|こうざ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解約|かいやく}→解約：06129_kaiyaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to close a bank account
- {預金|よきん}{口座|こうざ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{振|ふ}り{込|こ}む→振り込む：10992_furikomu⟧: to transfer money into an account
- {預金|よきん}{口座|こうざ}{番号|ばんごう}: account number

TYPES OF ACCOUNTS:
- ⟦{普通|ふつう}→普通：01502_futsuu⟧{預金|よきん}{口座|こうざ}: ordinary savings account (the standard personal account)
- ⟦{定期|ていき}→定期：03538_teiki⟧{預金|よきん}{口座|こうざ}: fixed-term deposit account
- ⟦{当座|とうざ}→当座：29548_touza⟧{預金|よきん}{口座|こうざ}: checking account (mainly for businesses)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{口座|こうざ}→口座：05419_kouza⟧: account — shorter, more general term often used on its own
- ⟦{銀行|ぎんこう}{口座|こうざ}→銀行口座：27021_ginkoukouza⟧: bank account — emphasizes the institution rather than the deposit type
- ⟦{貯金|ちょきん}→貯金：03497_chokin⟧: savings — the act of saving money, not the account itself
